gaps.title: The Level-4 protected-truth sufficiency gate is not met
gaps.whyItMatters: Two of four protected lakes have fewer than the required qualifying casts, so the frozen score cannot move.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the temperature estimate has been checked on a protected lake before it is trusted.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the missing casts exist and the owner approves the recount under the frozen rule, or the lakes are replaced.
gaps.expectedOutput: The Level-4 comparison and a scored result.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Reservoir-operator profiles or a prospective logger network, and owner approval to recount.

gaps.title: The model has a seasonal bias that no correction has yet beaten on independent data
gaps.whyItMatters: Spring runs cold and autumn warm in the fleet validation; corrections that help the fleet hurt some already-good lakes.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a spawn-window temperature is read too early or too late.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when six or more independent lake-surface logger lakes exist, or a correction passes the preregistered tests.
gaps.expectedOutput: A correction accepted or rejected on independent data.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Independent lake-surface (<=1.5 m) temperature logger series at six or more reservoirs.

gaps.title: The published error band is over-confident on independent lakes
gaps.whyItMatters: A stated 80% band covered only about two thirds of readings at two independent sensor lakes.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: How wide to treat the temperature estimate when a rule band is only a few degrees wide.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when an interval passes the preregistered calibration tests on independent lakes.
gaps.expectedOutput: A calibrated seasonal interval, or a documented wider fixed band.
